Definition: Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Two towns in the low country share this name. Judah went up to Timnath at sheepshearing time, and centuries later the Philistines invaded and took Timnah with its villages, holding it among the cities of Judah's low country.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two towns must be kept apart: the Timnah of Judah's story and the Timnah of the Philistine invasion are two places, and the Bible names them both without apology.
